title: openai-compat: normalize /v1/chat.completions response shaping, stop/logprobs and function-call wiring
author: Aisha Patel
description:
Context: This PR finishes a multi-iter effort to bring Redwood's OpenAI /v1/chat.completions compatibility layer closer to parity with the OpenAI reference behavior. Motivation: customers rely on OpenAI-shaped responses and third-party tooling that expects specific fields (choices[*].finish_reason, roles, stop handling, logprobs layout, function_call structure and streaming chunk semantics). Previous behavior diverged in several edge cases: - stop sequences were honored but produced inconsistent finish_reason and token trimming on streaming paths - logprobs were returned only for final responses, with an internal shape that differed from OpenAI's 'top_logprobs' and 'token_logprobs' naming - function calling (tool invocation) resulted in uneven streaming events and occasionally split the function call payload across multiple stream chunks, breaking consumer parsers - structured-output / json_schema enforcement worked for sync calls but not for streaming or when partial-function-call fragments were emitted This change set: - Unifies the response shaping layer so that both streaming and non-streaming paths emit the same final JSON shape for /v1/chat.completions. choices[*].message adheres to {role, content, function_call?} shape. choices[*].finish_reason maps to 'stop'|'length'|'function_call'|'null' exactly as OpenAI. - Stop handling: added a central tokenizer-aware stop-truncation utility used by both streaming encoder and sync writer. This ensures tokens corresponding to stop sequences are removed consistently and finish_reason='stop' is set on the last emitted choice. - Logprobs: introduced an opt-in top_logprobs and token_logprobs mapping that mirrors OpenAI's naming and nesting. Behind a compatibility flag openai.v1.logprobs_map=true the compatibility layer will emit: - choices[*].logprobs.token_logprobs (list of floats) - choices[*].logprobs.top_logprobs (list of small maps) - Streaming: streaming chunks now carry deterministic 'delta' shapes for role/content/function_call fragments. We coalesce partial function_call fragments server-side to avoid exposing mid-json fragments to clients and add sequence numbers to stream events (x-stream-seq) to help clients reassemble when they must. - Function calling: implement atomic function_call emission in streaming: a single final event contains the full serialized function call payload (name + arguments) and finish_reason=function_call. - Tests and docs: adds a comprehensive set of unit and integration tests (sync + streaming) that validate parity with a local OpenAI-compat mock harness, updates the OpenAI compatibility guide and the migration notes section in the docs site. Checklist: - [x] tokenizer-aware stop trimming implemented - [x] logprobs shape parity behind compatibility flag - [x] streaming stability fixes and coalescing - [x] end-to-end integration tests added - [x] docs/migration notes updated Backwards compatibility: default behavior is unchanged unless customers opt into the new logprobs_map flag. However, the streaming event coalescing is enabled by default because fragmentary function_call events were observed to be breaking for many downstream parsers. Migration notes: see release_notes field below and docs/openai-compat.md. Related: ENG-2412 (response-shaping), ENG-2479 (streaming stability), SUP-6781 (customer report)

Testing notes: ran unit tests, integration harness against openai-compat-mock v0.9, and an isolated smoke test with our Python SDK. Observed an intermittent e2e streaming flakiness early in the branch which was resolved by coalescing and sequence headers. CI: all checks passed on final run. Merge: squash and merge.
commits: refactor(openai-compat): extract response-shaping util and stop-truncation
feat(streaming): add x-stream-seq header and deterministic delta shapes
feat(func-call): coalesce function_call fragments and emit atomic payload
feat(logprobs): map internal logprob shape to openai top_logprobs/token_logprobs behind flag
test: add streaming+sync parity tests against openai-compat-mock
docs: add migration notes for /v1/chat.completions parity
review_comments: Marco Liu: Behavior looks good overall, left two inline suggestions around token boundary handling in response_shaper.py — please add a comment explaining the choice for trimming at sub-token seq boundaries.
Aisha Patel: addressed the inline comments, expanded unit test coverage for sub-token cases, and added a docstring to explain the heuristic — PTAL.
Noah Kim: Integration tests are thorough. One request: add an explicit test asserting that function_call is emitted in a single final stream event for large argument payloads (edge case).
Aisha Patel: added tests/e2e/test_streaming_function_call_large_args.py and validated locally against the mock harness. Pushed new commit.
Sofia Ramos: Approving — CI green and docs updated. Recommend alert to SDK owners so they can make minor changes to stream parsers.
CI Bot: All required checks passed (unit/integration/lint/e2e).
release_notes:
- /v1/chat.completions: improved OpenAI compatibility for response shapes (choices.message, finish_reason).
- Stop sequences: tokenizer-aware trimming now consistent across streaming and sync paths; finish_reason='stop' will be returned.
- Logprobs: opt-in compatibility flag openai.v1.logprobs_map=true emits top_logprobs/token_logprobs matching OpenAI naming.
- Streaming: deterministic delta shapes and x-stream-seq header added; function_call payloads are emitted atomically to avoid partial JSON fragments.
- Migration: SDK parsers that relied on fragmented function_call streaming should be updated; see docs/openai-compat.md for examples and a small code patch for Python/TS SDKs.
notes_for_release: Docs updated, migration guide added under pkg/console/migration/openai_chat_parity.md; ops flag openai.v1.logprobs_map is available for gradual rollouts.
hotfix_followups: None planned; will monitor streaming metrics and customer reports for two weeks post-release.
changelog_entry: openai-compat: /v1/chat.completions parity for stop/logprobs/streaming/function_call (non-breaking by default; opt-in logprobs mapping)
